aliases: Beale De Soto data center campus
status_as_of_cutoff: site work-construction as of 2026-08-11: De Soto's official Beale Data Center page states that the Phase 1 site plan for Buildings 1 and 2 has received conditional city approval and that grading and early site preparation are underway at Flint Commerce Center. The city also states that its council approved a Development Agreement with Mount Sunflower, LLC and IRB intent in August 2025. No building permit, inspection, certificate of occupancy, utility energization, commissioning, live-service record, or confirmed MW capacity was found in the reviewed public sources.
evidence_grade: official-local-government-confirmed site plan conditional approval and grading/site-prep; company/local-media corroboration; no operational or MW-capacity proof

actions.result_status: Beale announced the first phase, at least two facilities, four-building full buildout, more than one million square feet, approximately $3 billion development value, and a May site-preparation/groundbreaking plan; Evergy was identified as power partner.
actions.access_caveat: Company announcement; it does not establish a city/county approval, building permit, actual groundbreaking, or energized service.
actions.evidence_note: Tier-2 developer evidence retained as announcement context.

actions.result_status: Beale announced privately funded water-resiliency infrastructure for the De Soto campus. The company describes anticipated sewer, cooling-water, stormwater, wastewater, and Evergy infrastructure requirements, but no government permit or completed utility work was located.
actions.access_caveat: Company infrastructure claim; no municipal, KDHE, EPA, or Evergy permit/interconnection closeout was retrieved.
actions.evidence_note: Utility/water planning context, not evidence of construction or operation.

actions.result_status: The city lists Beale Infrastructure Data Center Campus as an active proposed project and explains that large industrial wastewater, zoning, stormwater, air-quality, water, and utility requirements apply. The page does not publish a project-specific approval, permit number, vote, inspection, or service date.
actions.access_caveat: City resource page and regulatory context; absence of a posted project file is preserved and no approval is inferred.
actions.evidence_note: Official local search surface confirms project identity and pending regulatory pathways.

actions.government_body: City of De Soto City Council
actions.result_status: City project page states the City Council approved a Development Agreement with Mount Sunflower, LLC and a Resolution of Intent to use IRB-based incentives for a multi-phase data center campus at Flint Commerce Center. The executed agreement says it was presented to and approved by City Council on August 21, 2025, and was made as of September 23, 2025.
actions.access_caveat: Development agreement and incentive intent are not building permits, certificates of occupancy, or evidence of energized service.
actions.evidence_note: Official city agreement establishes local economic-development approval and project party, with future final site plan/building approvals still handled separately.

actions.government_body: City of De Soto / Planning Commission
actions.action_type: Phase 1 site plan conditional approval / site-preparation status
actions.result_status: City project page states the Phase 1 site plan for Buildings 1 and 2 has received conditional approval and that grading and early site preparation activities are underway. The city lists the location as Flint Commerce Center at 103rd Street and Edgerton Road, up to four buildings in phases, approximately $3.1 billion estimated private investment, construction targeted to begin in 2026, and phased development through approximately 2035.
actions.access_caveat: The city page confirms conditional site-plan status and grading/site preparation, but does not publish a building permit number, inspection, certificate of occupancy, energization date, tenant/operator name, or MW capacity.
actions.evidence_note: Status upgraded from announced/local process to site work-construction because official local-government source says grading and early site preparation are underway.

actions.action_type: local media construction and size corroboration
actions.result_status: Local reporting says work is officially underway, construction began in April 2026, the site is at the northwest corner of 103rd Street and Edgerton Road, the Planning Commission approved scope changes in April and May, and the project now totals nearly 2.9 million square feet across four buildings.
actions.access_caveat: Media corroboration; official city page is used as the controlling status source.
actions.evidence_note: Corroborates site work and expanded square footage, but still does not provide confirmed MW capacity or operating status.

owner: Beale Infrastructure / Mount Sunflower Properties, LLC (developer/project entity); tenant/operator not publicly disclosed in reviewed sources
